title: PostHog
description: PostHog publishes its core brand colours on its official brand site: blue (#1490e8), cobalt (#0457ff), coral (#ff474d), corn blue (#2bb3df), green (#47c861), lemon (#ffce1c), lime (#a0ca21), purple (#a737d2), tangerine (#ff5c1c), teal (#43dab3), violet (#6d4fff) and yellow (#ffa81c).
